chapter: Sounds and recording in old New Orleans
title: Whether Armstrong played parades and funerals after fame
summary: Armstrong did not play parades when he came back; Alcorn recalls him as King of the Zulus and giving concerts.

bands.name: Zulu Social Aid and Pleasure Club

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: When you mentioned funerals, that's something I'm curious about. Do you recall Armstrong playing any funerals back then?
No, he wasn't playing no parades or nothing like that. He never played a parade again? No, he did that. Everybody knew him playing a parade again. No, I mean when he came back.
After he had made it big. No, no.

Because the last thing I was doing was when he was King of the Zool. I was playing with old man Allen. The great Allen's father. But when he was the king. He was on the floor just enjoying the music. He was right behind him with the music. Yeah. When he came out and played concerts. Uh huh. He played all the children in different places.
Do you remember some of the better concerts? With Lloyd?
